title: Guarded body round
statement: Let $B$ be a finite Boolean Turing machine with at least one work tape, let $q_v,q_i$ be states of $B$, and let $x,s$ be Boolean words. Suppose that from the seam configuration on input $x$ with state $q_v$ and word assignment placing $s$ on tape zero, $B$ halts within $T_v$ steps with output $[b]$, and from the corresponding configuration with state $q_i$, it halts within $T_i$ steps with output equal to the fixed-width increment of $s$, using the empty word if that increment overflows. Then there is an integer $t$ with $0<t\le 3T_v+3T_i+2|x|+3|s|+22$ such that, in the body machine with stopped flag false started at its anchor on the seam carrying $s$, no strictly intermediate positive-time configuration is at the anchor; at time $t$, if $b$ is true the machine is halted with output $[\mathrm{true}]$, and if $b$ is false it is at the anchor on the seam carrying the increment of $s$, with $s$ itself used when the increment overflows.
hypotheses_covered: $B$ is a finite Boolean Turing machine
$B$ has at least one work tape
the verification run from the seam with state $q_v$ halts at time $T_v$ and outputs $[b]$
the increment run from the seam with state $q_i$ halts at time $T_i$ and outputs the fixed-width increment of $s$, or the empty word on overflow
replaced:
Let $B$ be a source machine with at least one work tape whose verification call
on candidate $s$ halts within $T_v$ steps with single-bit verdict $b$, and whose
increment call halts within $T_i$ steps emitting the fixed-width increment
output. Then there is a time $t$ with
$0 < t \le 3T_v + 3T_i + 2|x| + 3|s| + 22$ such that the active enumerator body,
started at the anchor over the seam with candidate $s$, does not visit the
anchor at any strictly intermediate positive time, and at time $t$ either halts
with output true (when $b$ is true) or stands at the anchor over the seam
carrying the stalled increment of $s$ (when $b$ is false).
